failed_visual_description: Uniform yellow opaque cube caused by hardcoded 256x1 colormap in Viewport, fixed [0,1]^3 clipping bypassing physical clipping controls, and high initial opacity accumulation.
paper_reference: The Implementation of a WebGPU-Based Volume Rendering Framework for Interactive Visualization of Ocean Scalar Data (Yu et al., Appl. Sci. 2025, 15, 2782)
root_causes_identified: Hardcoded fallback colormap generation in OceanVolumeViewport.tsx ignoring TransferFunctionModel
PhysicalClippingModel limits not propagated into packet.clippingBox (remained {0,1}^3)
VolumeQualityModel step size and opacity multiplier not dynamically driving shader uniforms
Z-axis coordinate orientation inversion between WebGL Y-up NDC and oceanographic depth conventions
Lack of 3D spatial wireframe bounding box, depth ticks, and compass gizmo rendering in the 3D canvas stage
